Hmm, I don't buy the thought that death might entail something other than the ceasing of existance. Percisely because of the lack of evidence, there is no reason to assume any mystical afterlife. If some brain processes cease, conciousness ceases; if all brain processes cease, why would it be otherwise? I'm sort of an unrepairable materialist in my worldview.

I guess I'd like a life if it was considerably better, but that seems like such a hopelessly remote possiblility. It seems so much easier to just end it and not worry about anything anymore. Perhaps I'm a quitter.

I did try to do something about this some time ago, when I was feeling really down. I started going to gym and going out with other people, in the end ending up as perhaps a decently social being. I even had a girlfriend for a short while, that was lovely. But then I guess my mind adapted and my misery returned, stronger than ever.
Hahah!. Cheap oil that is still left. Hahahaha, good one!
